programme_facts.value: No need to submit a new application or application fee.
Sign in to My ASU and register for classes.

The catalog year upon re-entry will be determined via current policy.
International students are responsible for all SEVIS requirements and should check with the International Students and Scholars Center.
If absence is due to military deployment, service on an official church mission, foreign aid service, or permanent disability, a Leave of Absence must be submitted.
Official transcripts from all institutions attended during absence must be submitted directly to Admission Services.
Transcripts must be mailed or sent electronically by the records office and cannot be sent or carried by hand by applicants themselves or transmitted by fax.
International students eligible for quick re-entry should contact ASU's International Students and Scholars Center to submit documentation for issuance of an I-20.
Visit issc.asu.edu for more information regarding international students.
Students who have completed an ASU bachelor's degree program or were academically disqualified are not eligible for quick re-entry.
If you are not eligible for Quick Re-entry you must apply for readmission and submit applicable fees.
An applicant for readmission must have an ASU GPA of 2.00 or higher, depending on the ASU school or college.
Applicants must have left on good academic standing.
Students who do not meet the GPA and academic standing requirement may appeal.
Decisions for readmission appeals may take 4-6 weeks.
You must submit official transcripts from all institutions you attended during your absence from ASU.
Official transcripts must be mailed or sent electronically directly to Admission Services by the records office of the issuing institutions.
ASU does not accept transcripts sent or carried by hand by applicants themselves or transmitted by fax.
The priority readmission application deadline for fall semester is June 1.
Readmission applications received after June 1 will be considered on a space-available basis.
The priority readmission application deadline for spring semester is December 1.
Readmission applications received after December 1 will be considered on a space-available basis.
Space is limited in some programs and admission to these programs is more competitive.
